Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: http://vellore.nic.in.
Write the name of the post applied for on the envelope.
Enclose a self-addressed envelope with Rs. 25/- postal stamp.
Send applications to the address mentioned in the notification within 15 days of the newspaper advertisement.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DCPU Vellore Assistant cum Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Assistant cum Data Entry Operator post is 06 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed 12th grade with a Diploma or Certificate in Computers and possess Higher Grade Typewriting skills in both Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Assistant cum Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 42 years as of July 1, 2026. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant cum Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 11,916/-.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. You need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the specified address along with a self-addressed envelope and postal stamp.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant cum Data Entry Operator post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting candidates based on their qualifications and experience, followed by further procedures as per the organization's rules.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and download the application form from the official website of DCPU Vellore, which is http://vellore.nic.in.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a temporary or permanent job?
faq.answer: The Assistant cum Data Entry Operator post is a temporary position.
